Infleqtion Inc., a quantum‑computing firm, has entered into a collaboration with Cisco Systems Inc. to accelerate the development of networked quantum technologies. The partnership aims to combine Infleqtion’s quantum computation expertise with Cisco’s networking and communications infrastructure to create secure, integrated quantum communication solutions. The announcement was reported by Marketscreener.com.
